Name: Pathologic (CP)
Author: accursedpeanut
Description:
This mod uses Content Patcher to change UI, portraits and interiors to resemble Pathologic, the plague survival game by Ice Pick Lodge.

[size=3][b]Changes:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]User interface
[*]Fonts
[*]Dialog Portraits
[*]Map page
[*]Intro animation and title (including title easter egg)
[/list]V2:
[list]
[*]Entirely revamped interior design for villagers
[*]Hardcoded UI text color
[/list]
Map is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33462545]Bouhm[/url]'s more accurate [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url] map.

Includes [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33462545]zazizu3[/url]'s [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4056/?tab=description]White Text[/url] mod which changes the hardcoded UI text color.

I plan on adding more changes in the future, from character sprites to music to new maps. The goal is to see how much I can transform the upbeat, vanilla experience of Stardew Valley into Pathologic's grim universe! This is my first mod so please feel free to suggest future changes or point out issues with the mod.
